import pandas as pd
from src import HearingTagger
from src.grammar.Parser import Parser
from src.grammar.Grammar import SectionEnum, TerminalEnum
from src.dataclasses.Hearing import Hearing
from src.speakers.Speaker import Speaker
from src.speakers.enums.SpeakerPositionEnum import SpeakerPositionEnum
from src.dataclasses.OralContribution import TaggedOralContribution
from datetime import datetime

df = pd.read_csv(''''utterances_sample_labeled.csv'''')
hid = 54069
hearing_df = df[df[''''hid''''] == hid].copy()
first_row = hearing_df.iloc[0]

speakers = {}
for pid in hearing_df[''''pid''''].unique():
    pid_rows = hearing_df[hearing_df[''''pid''''] == pid]
    speaker_position_str = pid_rows.iloc[0][''''speaker.position'''']
    try:
        speaker_position = SpeakerPositionEnum[speaker_position_str]
    except (KeyError, AttributeError):
        speaker_position = None
    speakers[pid] = Speaker(pid=pid, first_name=None, last_name=None, speaker_position=speaker_position,
        can_file_motions=None, is_presenter=None, first_mention_uid=None,
        first_uid=int(pid_rows[''''uid''''].min()), last_uid=int(pid_rows[''''uid''''].max()))

utterances = []
for _, row in hearing_df.iterrows():
    utt = TaggedOralContribution(uid=int(row[''''uid'''']), pid=int(row[''''pid'''']), text=str(row[''''text'''']),
        pids_mentioned=None, bill_mentioned=None, relative_position=None, token_count=None,
        sent_count=None, speech_act_cues=None, section_cues=None, section=None)
    utterances.append(utt)

hearing = Hearing(state=first_row[''''state''''], bid=first_row[''''bid''''], hid=int(hid), cid=0,
    cname=''''Unknown'''', hearing_date=datetime(2015, 1, 1), speakers=speakers, utterances=utterances)

tagger = HearingTagger()
parser = Parser()
tagged = tagger(hearing)
tokens = parser.tokenizer.tokenize(tagged)
table, backpointers = parser._cyk_parse(tokens)

# Check the SECRETARY -> COMMITTEE_MEMBER spans
print(''''Checking SECRETARY -> COMMITTEE_MEMBER bigrams:'''')
for i in range(len(tokens) - 1):
    if tokens[i][0] == SpeakerPositionEnum.SECRETARY and tokens[i+1][0] == SpeakerPositionEnum.COMMITTEE_MEMBER:
        print(f''''\nPositions {i}-{i+1}:'''')
        print(f''''  table[{i}][{i+1}] = {table[i][i+1]}'''')
        print(f''''  Contains SectionEnum.VOTE? {SectionEnum.VOTE in table[i][i+1]}'''')
        print(f''''  Contains TerminalEnum.SECRETARY? {TerminalEnum.SECRETARY in table[i][i]}'''')
        print(f''''  Contains TerminalEnum.COMMITTEE_MEMBER? {TerminalEnum.COMMITTEE_MEMBER in table[i+1][i+1]}'''')
")
